asset_ai_fields_check.name: asset_ai_fields_check
asset_ai_fields_check.value: "asset"."source" <> 'ai' or ("asset"."prompt" is not null and "asset"."model" is not null)

credit_transaction_amount_check.name: credit_transaction_amount_check
credit_transaction_amount_check.value:
case
            when "credit_transaction"."kind" in ('topup', 'refund') then "credit_transaction"."amount" > 0
            when "credit_transaction"."kind" = 'usage' then "credit_transaction"."amount" < 0
            else "credit_transaction"."amount" <> 0
          end
